production_signal.description: Derivative of node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total counter over 2-minute window, scaled to percentage
production_signal.interpretation: Rate of change of PSI memory waiting time (percent per second)
production_signal.time_window: avg10 equivalent (Prometheus rate over 2m approximates 10s average)
notes: This is a Prometheus query, not direct /proc/pressure/memory read
Uses deriv() to compute rate from counter
Multiplies by 100 to convert to percentage

host_psi_direct.description: Direct read from kernel PSI interface
notes: Available on host with kernel >= 4.20 and CONFIG_PSI=y
This experiment will use avg10 to match production's ~10s window

experiment_signal.reason: Experiment runs without full Prometheus stack; will read /proc/pressure/memory directly from pod cgroup
